title: Prove rh_implies_mertens_bound: M(x) = O(x^{1/2+ε}) under RH

currentState.focus: Initial problem understanding. Read `problem.md`, survey parent proof (`src/data/proofs/rh-consequences/`) for how RH is encoded, and probe Mathlib for Möbius summatory-function and Perron/Mellin infrastructure.
currentState.nextAction: Audit Mathlib coverage of `ArithmeticFunction.moebius` partial sums and any Perron-formula machinery; decide whether the first ACT goal is the Perron representation or the conditional 1/ζ bound.

knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEYED (ORIENT, build-blocked): forward implication RH => M(x)=O(x^{1/2+eps}). Route = truncated Perron inversion of 1/zeta + conditional critical-strip 1/zeta bound under RH. Recommend axiom-boundary refactor (P Perron + Z conditional 1/zeta bound + VERIFIED Assembly). Full proof BLOCKED (>1000 lines Mathlib gap); Assembly lemma ~150-300 lines is tractable target. FLAG: parent axiom uses <=C*sqrt(x) form which overclaims (believed false) — true consequence is eps-form.
insights: I1: Parent axiom rh_implies_mertens_bound uses |M(x)|<=C*sqrt(x), which OVERCLAIMS — that bound is believed false (contradicts limsup M(x)/sqrt(x) oscillation Omega-results). The genuine RH consequence is the eps-form: for all eps>0, M(x)=O(x^{1/2+eps}) (Littlewood). Any discharge must use the eps-form.

I2: The RH=>bound implication factors: RH enters ONLY via (a) zeta!=0 for Re s>1/2 (no pole crossed except s=0, residue 1/zeta(0)=-2) and (b) conditional growth |1/zeta(1/2+eps+it)| << |t|^eps (Titchmarsh Thm 14.2). Everything else is RH-free Perron/contour machinery.

I3 (actionable): Refactor the monolithic axiom into (P) truncated Perron representation of M(x) [RH-free] + (Z) conditional 1/zeta bound [RH] + a VERIFIED Assembly estimate (shift contour, |x^s|=x^{1/2+eps}, integrate <<(1+|t|)^{eps-1} to T, optimize T~x). Improves axiom hygiene and yields partial verified progress.
Scope split: oq-01 = forward direction (RH=>bound); sibling oq-03 = full Littlewood equivalence RH<=>bound. Keep the converse out of oq-01.
mathlibGaps: No truncated Perron formula for L-series summatory functions in mainline mathlib4 (PrimeNumberTheoremAnd has a different Newman-Tauberian route, not upstreamed). Est. 400-800 lines. = input (P).

No conditional critical-strip 1/zeta growth bound |1/zeta(sigma+it)| << |t|^eps under RH (needs Borel-Caratheodory + Hadamard three-circles on log zeta; Titchmarsh Ch.14). Est. 500-1000+ lines. = input (Z).
No explicit formula for M(x) = sum over rho of x^rho/(rho*zetaprime(rho)) + ... in terms of nontrivial zeros (alternative route).
nextSteps: When build infra returns: create RiemannHypothesisConsequencesOQ01.lean with typed axioms perron_mertens (P) + inv_zeta_bound_of_RH (Z); prove Assembly lemma mertens_bound_of_perron_and_zeta_bound : RiemannHypothesis -> for all eps>0, exists C>0, for all n>=1, |mertens n| <= C*(n:R)^(1/2+eps).
Open a correctness note against parent RiemannHypothesisConsequences.lean to soften axiom rh_implies_mertens_bound from <=C*sqrt(x) to the eps-form.
Long-horizon Mathlib contribution: truncated Perron for L-series (input P), general interest, unblocks PNT-adjacent work.
